desc.en: Free tier offers 1 uptime/API monitor with 15-minute check intervals and instant email alerts.
desc.zh: 免费套餐提供 1 个可用性/API 监控，检查间隔 15 分钟，并提供即时邮件告警。

desc.en: Accesserty Pulse monitors interaction signals and detectable accessibility risks on live websites. Free plans for everyone and 14-day Pro trial.
desc.zh: Accesserty Pulse 监控线上网站的交互信号和可检测的无障碍风险。提供面向所有人的免费套餐，以及 14 天 Pro 试用。

desc.en: server security (eBPF agent for Linux), uptime monitoring, on-call alerting/status pages in one product. Free tier includes 10 uptime monitors and heartbeats, 5-minute check intervals, 7-day retention.
desc.zh: 一款产品集成服务器安全（面向 Linux 的 eBPF 代理）、可用性监控、值班告警/状态页。免费套餐包含 10 个可用性监控和心跳检测，检查间隔 5 分钟，保留期 7 天。

desc.en: Automated API testing and monitoring. Free plans for teams and individuals.
desc.zh: 自动化 API 测试与监控。面向团队和个人的免费套餐。

desc.en: Uptime monitoring, incident management, on-call scheduling/alerting, and status pages in a single product. The free plan includes ten monitors with 3-minute check frequency and status pages.
desc.zh: 一款产品集成可用性监控、事件管理、值班排班/告警和状态页。免费套餐包含十个监控，检查频率 3 分钟，并提供状态页。

desc.en: Free for 3 servers, 5 uptime monitors, unlimited users, unlimited dashboards, unlimited alerting rules.
desc.zh: 免费支持 3 台服务器、5 个可用性监控，用户、仪表板和告警规则均不限。

desc.en: Open source E2E / Synthetic monitoring and deep API monitoring for developers. Free plan with one user and 10k API & network / 1.5k browser check runs.
desc.zh: 面向开发者的开源 E2E/合成监控和深度 API 监控。免费套餐含 1 名用户，以及 10k 次 API 与网络检查 / 1.5k 次浏览器检查运行。

desc.en: Find Core Web Vitals history for a url or a website.
desc.zh: 查询某个 URL 或网站的 Core Web Vitals 历史记录。

desc.en: Heartbeat monitoring for cron jobs, plus HTTP uptime and TLS expiry checks, and a Laravel package that creates checks from your scheduler. Free tier with 10 checks, HTTP interval from 5 min, 30 days of history, 50k pings/mo.
desc.zh: cron 任务心跳监控，以及 HTTP 可用性和 TLS 到期检查，并提供可从调度器创建检查的 Laravel 包。免费套餐含 10 个检查、HTTP 间隔从 5 分钟起、30 天历史记录、每月 50k 次 ping。

desc.en: Performance insights and uptime monitoring for cron jobs, websites, APIs and more. A free tier with five monitors.
desc.zh: 面向 cron 任务、网站、API 等的性能洞察和可用性监控。提供含五个监控的免费套餐。

desc.en: Free for up to 5 nodes
desc.zh: 免费支持最多 5 个节点

desc.en: Rails APM with request-based pricing: live traces, slow SQL, N+1 detection, and error tracking. Free forever for 50k requests/month, 7-day retention, 1 app, 1 uptime check, and email alerts. No credit card required.
desc.zh: Rails APM，按请求计费：实时链路追踪、慢 SQL、N+1 检测和错误跟踪。永久免费支持每月 50k 次请求、保留期 7 天、1 个应用、1 个可用性检查和邮件告警。无需信用卡。

desc.en: Monitoring for cron jobs. One free snitch (monitor), more if you refer others to sign up
desc.zh: cron 任务监控。免费一个 snitch（监控器），推荐他人注册可获得更多

desc.en: 60 uptime monitors, 5-minute interval. Email, Slack alerts.
desc.zh: 60 个可用性监控，间隔 5 分钟。支持邮件、Slack 告警。

desc.en: Cron, heartbeat, and uptime monitoring with incident management and status pages. Free for up to 50 monitors with 1-min interval and unlimited team seats.
desc.zh: cron、心跳和可用性监控，带事件管理和状态页。免费支持最多 50 个监控，间隔 1 分钟，团队席位不限。

desc.en: Economize helps demystify cloud infrastructure costs by organizing cloud resources to optimize and report the same. Free for up to $5,000 spent on Google Cloud Platform every month.
desc.zh: Economize 通过梳理云资源来优化并报告云基础设施成本，让成本一目了然。每月在 Google Cloud Platform 消费不超过 $5,000 的用户可免费使用。

desc.en: Linux server monitoring with real‑time dashboards and alerting - free forever for up to 5 monitored servers at 60-seconds interval. No credit card required.
desc.zh: Linux 服务器监控，带实时仪表板和告警——永久免费支持最多 5 台受监控服务器，间隔 60 秒。无需信用卡。

desc.en: Uptime, content, dependency, and SSL monitoring with multi-region verification and status pages. Free plan includes 15 monitors, 5-minute checks, and 90 days of history.
desc.zh: 可用性、内容、依赖项和 SSL 监控，支持多区域验证和状态页。免费套餐包含 15 个监控、5 分钟检查和 90 天历史记录。

desc.en: Grafana Cloud is a composable observability platform that integrates metrics and logs with Grafana. Free: 3 users, ten dashboards, 100 alerts, metrics storage in Prometheus and Graphite (10,000 series, 14 days retention), logs storage in Loki (50 GB of logs, 14 days retention)
desc.zh: Grafana Cloud 是一个可组合的可观测性平台，将指标和日志与 Grafana 集成。免费版：3 名用户、十个仪表板、100 条告警，指标存储于 Prometheus 和 Graphite（10,000 个序列，保留期 14 天），日志存储于 Loki（50 GB 日志，保留期 14 天）

desc.en: Monitor your cron jobs and background tasks. Free for up to 20 checks.
desc.zh: 监控你的 cron 任务和后台任务。免费支持最多 20 个检查。

desc.en: Cloud and SaaS status page aggregator - 20 monitors and 2 notification channels (Slack and Discord) are free forever.
desc.zh: 云和 SaaS 状态页聚合器——20 个监控和 2 个通知渠道（Slack 和 Discord）永久免费。

desc.en: A complete Real-Time monitoring dashboard in less than one minute with a free forever tier.
desc.zh: 不到一分钟即可搭建完整的实时监控仪表板，提供永久免费套餐。

desc.en: Get a beautiful status page in 10 seconds. Free forever with unlimited subs and unlimited teams.
desc.zh: 10 秒获得精美的状态页。永久免费，订阅者和团队数量不限。

desc.en: Free public JSON API returning real-time status for 500+ popular services (GitHub, Stripe, AWS, etc.). No auth required, CORS enabled.
desc.zh: 免费的公共 JSON API，返回 500+ 热门服务（GitHub、Stripe、AWS 等）的实时状态。无需认证，支持 CORS。

desc.en: Dead man's switch for AI agents, cron jobs and CI. Free for individuals with unlimited monitors and destinations. Let AI agents build monitoring for everything including themselves.
desc.zh: 面向 AI 代理、cron 任务和 CI 的死亡开关。个人使用免费，监控和通知目标不限。让 AI 代理为包括自身在内的一切构建监控。

desc.en: Online broken link checker, free for small websites up to 100 pages, completely free for open-source projects.
desc.zh: 在线死链检查工具，100 页以内的小型网站免费，开源项目完全免费。

desc.en: Free load testing tools with limitations
desc.zh: 免费负载测试工具，有一定限制

desc.en: Server monitoring, public status pages, and service uptime monitoring.
desc.zh: 服务器监控、公共状态页和服务可用性监控。

desc.en: Middleware observability platform provides complete visibility into your apps & stack, so you can monitor & diagnose issues at scale. They have a free forever plan for Dev community use that allows Log monitoring for up to 1M log events, Infrastructure monitoring & APM for up to 2 hosts.
desc.zh: Middleware 可观测性平台提供对应用和技术栈的完整可见性，让你能够大规模监控和诊断问题。提供面向开发者社区的永久免费套餐，支持监控最多 1M 个日志事件的日志，以及最多 2 台主机的基础设施监控与 APM。

desc.en: Minimalist uptime monitoring with beautiful status pages. The Forever Free plan offers HTTPS, Keyword, SSL and Response-time monitorming for 10 websites or api-endpoints, and provides 2 dashboards/status pages.
desc.zh: 极简的可用性监控，带精美的状态页。永久免费套餐为 10 个网站或 API 端点提供 HTTPS、关键字、SSL 和响应时间监控，并提供 2 个仪表板/状态页。

desc.en: Netdata is an open-source tool to collect real-time metrics. It's a growing product and can also be found on GitHub!
desc.zh: Netdata 是一个收集实时指标的开源工具。产品仍在成长中，也可以在 GitHub 上找到它！

desc.en: New Relic observability platform built to help engineers create more perfect software. From monoliths to serverless, you can instrument everything and then analyze, troubleshoot, and optimize your entire software stack. The free tier offers 100GB/month of free data ingest, one free full-access user, and unlimited free primary users.
desc.zh: New Relic 可观测性平台旨在帮助工程师打造更完美的软件。从单体应用到无服务器，你可以为所有内容插桩，然后分析、排查并优化整个软件栈。免费套餐提供每月 100GB 免费数据摄入、一个完全访问权限用户，以及不限数量的免费主要用户。

desc.en: OnlineOrNot provides uptime monitoring for websites and APIs, monitoring for cron jobs and scheduled tasks. Also provides status pages. The first five checks with a 3-minute interval are free. The free tier sends alerts via Slack, Discord, and Email.
desc.zh: OnlineOrNot 为网站和 API 提供可用性监控，为 cron 任务和计划任务提供监控，还提供状态页。前五个检查（间隔 3 分钟）免费。免费套餐通过 Slack、Discord 和邮件发送告警。

desc.en: Check if a website is blocked in China by the Great Firewall. It identifies DNS pollution by comparing DNS results and ASN information detected by servers in China versus servers in the United States.
desc.zh: 检测网站是否在中国被防火长城（GFW）屏蔽。通过对比中国境内服务器与美国服务器检测到的 DNS 结果和 ASN 信息，识别 DNS 污染。

desc.en: Monitor website changes, free for up to 6 monitors with daily checks.
desc.zh: 监控网站变化，免费支持最多 6 个监控，每天检查。

desc.en: Simple interface for alerting and on-call management. Free up to 5 users.
desc.zh: 简单的告警和值班管理界面。免费支持最多 5 名用户。

desc.en: Uptime Monitoring free for up to 100,000 events for unlimited projects and unlimited status pages.
desc.zh: 可用性监控，免费支持最多 100,000 个事件，项目和状态页不限。

desc.en: Modern uptime monitoring service. Check unlimited URLs and get downtime notifications via Discord, Slack, or email.
desc.zh: 现代化的可用性监控服务。检查不限数量的 URL，并通过 Discord、Slack 或邮件接收宕机通知。

desc.en: 5 uptime monitors with 10-minute interval. Monitor SSH, HTTP, HTTPS, and any custom TCP ports.
desc.zh: 5 个可用性监控，间隔 10 分钟。监控 SSH、HTTP、HTTPS 和任何自定义 TCP 端口。

desc.en: Advanced status page platform with monitoring. The free tier includes one public customizable status page with an SSL subdomain. Pro plan is offered to open-source projects and non-profits free of charge.
desc.zh: 高级状态页平台，带监控功能。免费套餐包含一个带 SSL 子域名的可定制公共状态页。开源项目和非营利组织可免费使用 Pro 套餐。

desc.en: Free REST API (GET /api/v1/statuses) returning real-time operational status for 75+ AI services including OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral, and more. No authentication required. [Free tier available with Pro at $10/month]
desc.zh: 免费 REST API（GET /api/v1/statuses），返回 75+ AI 服务（包括 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、Mistral 等）的实时运行状态。无需认证。[提供免费套餐，Pro 为 $10/月]

desc.en: 10 monitors, 6 Months of historical Uptime/Logs, unlimited status pages, and custom domains included! For infinite time and unlimited email alerts for free. You don't need a credit card.
desc.zh: 10 个监控、6 个月历史可用性/日志、不限数量的状态页，并包含自定义域名！永久免费提供不限数量的邮件告警。无需信用卡。

desc.en: Powerful Kubernetes monitoring based on Prometheus. Bring your own Prometheus or install the all-in-one bundle. The free tier includes up to 20 Kubernetes nodes. Alerts via Slack, Microsoft Teams, Discord, and more. Integrations with PagerDuty, OpsGenie, VictorOps, DataDog, and many other tools.
desc.zh: 基于 Prometheus 的强大 Kubernetes 监控。可使用你自己的 Prometheus，或安装一体化套件。免费套餐包含最多 20 个 Kubernetes 节点。通过 Slack、Microsoft Teams、Discord 等发送告警。与 PagerDuty、OpsGenie、VictorOps、DataDog 等众多工具集成。

desc.en: On-call alerting, incident management, and public/private status pages. The free plan includes up to 5 users, 1 team, 1 on-call schedule, basic status pages, incident lifecycle, and Slack-native incident response.
desc.zh: 值班告警、事件管理和公共/私有状态页。免费套餐包含最多 5 名用户、1 个团队、1 个值班排班、基础状态页、事件生命周期，以及 Slack 原生事件响应。

desc.en: Advanced uptime monitoring with support for large projects and teams. Provides HTTP monitoring, Browser based monitoring, DNS monitoring, domain monitoring, status pages and more. The free tier includes 10 HTTP monitors, 1 DNS monitor and one status page.
desc.zh: 高级可用性监控，支持大型项目和团队。提供 HTTP 监控、基于浏览器的监控、DNS 监控、域名监控、状态页等。免费套餐包含 10 个 HTTP 监控、1 个 DNS 监控和一个状态页。

desc.en: Powerful server monitoring in a unified platform for metrics and logs, with no setup complexity. Free for one server.
desc.zh: 统一平台中的强大服务器监控，整合指标和日志，无配置复杂度。一台服务器免费。

desc.en: Website and cron monitoring - 2 monitors free
desc.zh: 网站和 cron 监控——2 个监控免费

desc.en: Free for first 100,000 requests (Rails only)
desc.zh: 前 100,000 次请求免费（仅限 Rails）

desc.en: Website monitoring, unlimited tests free with limitations
desc.zh: 网站监控，不限数量的测试免费，有一定限制

desc.en: Status page monitoring, 3 monitors free
desc.zh: 状态页监控，3 个监控免费

desc.en: Synthetic monitoring from 20+ global regions. The free tier includes 1,000 browser checks/mo with AI-driven self-healing and automated test generation.
desc.zh: 来自 20+ 全球区域的合成监控。免费套餐包含每月 1,000 次浏览器检查，带 AI 驱动的自愈和自动化测试生成。

desc.en: Open-source OpenTelemetry observability (traces, logs, and metrics) with AI-agent incident investigation. The free tier includes 1M spans, 5M logs, and 10M metric points per month with 30-day retention, no credit card required. Fully open-source and self-hostable.
desc.zh: 开源 OpenTelemetry 可观测性（链路、日志和指标），带 AI 代理事件调查。免费套餐包含每月 1M 个 span、5M 条日志和 10M 个指标点，保留期 30 天，无需信用卡。完全开源并可自托管。

desc.en: Server monitoring, uptime monitoring, DNS & domain monitoring. Monitor 10 server, 10 uptime, and 10 domain for free.
desc.zh: 服务器监控、可用性监控、DNS 和域名监控。免费监控 10 台服务器、10 项可用性和 10 个域名。

desc.en: Noncommercial free server monitoring service, alerts and metrics.
desc.zh: 非商业用途的免费服务器监控服务，提供告警和指标。

desc.en: Get 20 uptime monitors with 5-minute intervals and a customizable status page-even for commercial use. Enjoy unlimited, real-time notifications via email and Telegram. No credit card needed to get started.
desc.zh: 获得 20 个间隔 5 分钟的可用性监控和一个可定制状态页——即使商业用途亦可。通过邮件和 Telegram 接收不限数量的实时通知。上手无需信用卡。

desc.en: Free monitoring for five websites, 3-minute intervals, public statuspage.
desc.zh: 免费监控五个网站，间隔 3 分钟，提供公共状态页。

desc.en: monitor five pages, checks every 24 hours.
desc.zh: 监控五个页面，每 24 小时检查一次。

desc.en: Cron job and heartbeat monitoring and status pages for scheduled tasks, backups and background jobs, MCP server available. Free tier: 10 checks, 200 ping log entries, email/chat/webhook alerts, no credit card. Open Source support program for qualifying OS projects.
desc.zh: 面向计划任务、备份和后台作业的 cron 任务与心跳监控及状态页，提供 MCP 服务器。免费套餐：10 个检查、200 条 ping 日志条目，支持邮件/聊天/Webhook 告警，无需信用卡。符合条件的开源项目可参加开源支持计划。

desc.en: Uptime monitoring: 20 free, Linux and Windows Server monitoring: 5 free, Status page: 1 free - Mobile app, multiple notification channel, and much more!
desc.zh: 可用性监控：20 个免费；Linux 和 Windows Server 监控：5 个免费；状态页：1 个免费——还有移动应用、多个通知渠道等！

desc.en: Free uptime monitoring for hobby projects. Includes 50 monitors with 5-minute check intervals, supports HTTP, ping, port, and keyword monitoring.
desc.zh: 面向个人爱好项目的免费可用性监控。包含 50 个监控，检查间隔 5 分钟，支持 HTTP、ping、端口和关键字监控。
